Approvals

Fill this in once. Nothing changes on the site from this page. At the end it makes a file of your answers, and you can see exactly what those would change before anything is written.

1. Last date for each poster

Enter the date of the last gig on the poster, or tick "No end date". Click a poster to see it larger, and again to shrink it. Each poster disappears the day after its last date.

2. Names list

One name per line. Correct, add or delete directly in the boxes. These are the spellings "Did you mean…?" will suggest to the editor.

Presenters

Events and acts

"Gloria" and "Gina" come from album titles such as "Gina, Dale Haze & The Champions". Delete them if they shouldn't stand alone.

Venues

Always kept exactly as written

"Normand Boland" and "Seamus Fitzsimmons" were in the interviews you removed, so they're no longer on the site. Delete Normand Boland here if it's no longer needed.

Known misspellings

Tick each pair you approve. Only ticked pairs are used. He's always asked "Did you mean…?"; nothing changes silently. "Danny" on its own isn't here, because it could be Danny Tobin or Danny O'Leary, so he'd be offered both.
